title: Award record
slide_intent: Separate recognition from design instruction because an award establishes reception rather than a reusable rule.
strategic_value: The award panel can document external recognition of the Lufthansa refresh without proving specific audience outcomes.
demonstration: Four award marks form a two-by-two panel, including dated 2018 and 2019 awards.
practical_value: Use the panel as provenance of recognition, not as evidence that every design choice is effective.

content_islands.name: Award grid
content_islands.spec: Retain the four award marks and their dates in the balanced white panel.
